Problem Statement:
Aliens are invading the planet and it is your job to fight them off . There are N aliens each having a power P[i] (1<=i<=N) . You have a ray gun which can fire two types of beams. Beam A can decrease the power of a single alien by X Beam B can decrease the power of a single alien by Y Whenever an alien's power reduces to 0 it is defeated While you are fighting off the aliens you also want to report the number of defeated aliens to the Military. The military asks questions of the form: "What is the total number of defeated aliens from alien number 'x' to alien number 'y' " Write a program to simulate the above scenario Note: If you shoot a beam at an already defeated alien , its power remains 0 and does not decrease further. It is possible that you may shoot at an already defeated alien
input_spec:
The first line contains three integers N X Y - the number of aliens, The power of beam A and the power of beam B
The second line contains the Powers of the N aliens numbered from 1 to N
The next line contains the number of events Q
The next Q lines can be either of the following:
1 x y : shoot alien x with beam y ( 1<=x<=N and y is either ‘A’ or ‘B’)
2 x y: report the total number of defeated aliens from alien x to alien y
output_spec: For each type 2 event report the number of defeated aliens for the given range
